name: Aparat (www.aparat.com) — Persian video-sharing platform
description: Aparat (آپارات) is Iran's largest Persian-language video-sharing service (the 'Iranian YouTube'). NOT an AI chat site — the ui2api surface here is video discovery: search, trending, and video-detail reads driven through the site's own JS-rendered SPA. LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-20 against the attached real Chrome (CDP :9222): search 'موزیک' → 60 a[href*='/v/'] result anchors; homepage /home → 52 anchors; /v/mindkye → h1 title + div.description + 22 related anchors. Anti-bot: none observed.
author: ui2api capabilities
siteVersion: JS-rendered SPA (styled-components; raw HTML carries ZERO anchors — /home 196KB, /search/<q> 47KB). Verified UI classes 2026-09-20: thumb-wrapper / poster cards, h1 'heading title', div.description. og: metas NOT populated on /v/<id> (only og:site_name site-wide).

transport.protocol: DOM read of the site's own JS-rendered pages (https://www.aparat.com/search/<q>, /home trending, /v/<id> video pages); no wire RPC captured yet. VERIFIED 2026-09-20 on attached real Chrome.
transport.streaming: n/a (video site, not a chat stream)

auth.scheme: cookie session (anonymous browsing supported for search/watch; login needed only for upload/like/playlist actions)

antiBot.observed: none 2026-09-20 — attached real Chrome (CDP :9222) received fully rendered content on /home, /search/<q>, /v/<id>; no block page, no CAPTCHA. Headless-fresh contexts not separately probed.

capabilities.name: Video search
capabilities.description: Search Aparat videos by loading https://www.aparat.com/search/<url-encoded-query> in the real browser and reading the result grid the site's own JS renders. VERIFIED 2026-09-20: 'موزیک' → 60 a[href*='/v/'] anchors; header search input is input[name='search'] (placeholder 'جستجوی ویدیو در آپارات'), typing + Enter navigates via the site's own JS. Each video is double-anchored (thumbnail img.alt=duration + title anchor) — dedupe by /v/<id>, strip ?discovery/?refererRef suffixes.
capabilities.method: ui-path (navigate to /search/<q>, read rendered results) — LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-20
capabilities.implementation: openPage() → goto /search/<q> → waitForSelector("a[href*='/v/']") (~7-10s hydration; readyState is NOT enough) → dedupe anchors by /v/<id> → titles (skip duration-only img.alt like '2:03:10') + bare URLs. Implemented in src/capabilities/araprat.ts.

capabilities.name: Trending / homepage videos
capabilities.description: Read the homepage's trending/recommended video grid from the live rendered DOM. VERIFIED 2026-09-20: www.aparat.com → /home renders 52 a[href*='/v/'] anchors anonymously. Card wrappers are styled-components hashed classes (thumb-wrapper / poster) — the /v/ anchor is the stable selector.
capabilities.implementation: openPage() → goto https://www.aparat.com (301s to /home) → waitForSelector("a[href*='/v/']") → dedupe + titles. Implemented in src/capabilities/araparat.ts.

capabilities.name: Video detail
capabilities.description: Read one video page's metadata from https://www.aparat.com/v/<id>. VERIFIED 2026-09-20 on /v/mindkye: h1 carries the title, div.description the Persian description, a[href*='/v/'] the related grid (~22). The SPA does NOT populate og:/twitter: meta tags on /v/<id> — h1 + div.description are the verified reads.
capabilities.implementation: openPage() → goto /v/<id> → waitForSelector('h1') → read h1 + div.description + deduped a[href*='/v/'] related list. Implemented in src/capabilities/araparat.ts.
